findings.title: UsernameForm calls a method that does not exist
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate now calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only method added on UsernamePasswordForm is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel). UsernameForm does not define a no-arg overload, so this class does not compile and the re-authentication skip change cannot be built or shipped. The call needs to pass the user (or a real no-arg helper) or the authenticator factory will fail to compile.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys UI is skipped when the user is not yet known
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled requires a non-null user, and both authenticate() (around line 115) and the error challenge (around line 137) only call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm when that returns true. Previously the WebAuthn conditional UI (challenge, rpId, ENABLE_WEBAUTHN_CONDITIONAL_UI) was filled exactly when the user was not already selected, which is the discoverable-credential / passkey login page. After this change that initial form is no longer prepared, so realm passkeys login from the username or username/password page stops working, and a user-not-found error page also loses the passkey form. Re-authentication needs the fill to run when the user is already set; it should not replace the unidentified-user case. Gate on passkeys being enabled, not on user != null.
